name: io.github.Bitfloo/mailoo
description: Mailoo — email MCP server for IMAP, SMTP, and ManageSieve. Multi-account, per-folder profiles.

runtimeArguments.description: Accept the npm install without a prompt

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_ADDRESS
environmentVariables.description: Email address. Required for the environment-variable account.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Password or app password. Required unless MCP_EMAIL_OAUTH2_PROVIDER is set.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_IMAP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: IMAP server hostname.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_SMTP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: SMTP server hostname.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_ACCOUNT_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Account name. Defaults to default.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_FULL_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Display name on sent mail.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Login username. Defaults to the email address.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_IMAP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: IMAP port. Defaults to 993.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_IMAP_TLS
environmentVariables.description: Set to false to turn off implicit IMAP TLS. Defaults to true.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_IMAP_STARTTLS
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to upgrade IMAP with STARTTLS. Defaults to false.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_IMAP_VERIFY_SSL
environmentVariables.description: Set to false to skip IMAP certificate verification. Defaults to true.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_IMAP_DISABLE_IMAP4REV2
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to force IMAP4rev1 SEARCH.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_SIEVE_HOST
environmentVariables.description: ManageSieve hostname. Defaults to the IMAP host.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_SIEVE_PORT
environmentVariables.description: ManageSieve port. Defaults to 4190.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_SMTP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: SMTP port. Defaults to 465.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_SMTP_TLS
environmentVariables.description: Set to false to turn off implicit SMTP TLS. Defaults to true.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_SMTP_STARTTLS
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to upgrade SMTP with STARTTLS. Defaults to false.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_SMTP_VERIFY_SSL
environmentVariables.description: Set to false to skip SMTP certificate verification. Defaults to true.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_SMTP_POOL_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Set to false to disable SMTP connection pooling. Defaults to true.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_SMTP_POOL_MAX_CONNECTIONS
environmentVariables.description: Maximum pooled SMTP connections. Defaults to 1.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_SMTP_POOL_MAX_MESSAGES
environmentVariables.description: Maximum messages per pooled SMTP connection. Defaults to 100.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_OAUTH2_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: OAuth2 provider: google, microsoft, or custom.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_OAUTH2_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: OAuth2 client id.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_OAUTH2_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: OAuth2 client secret.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_OAUTH2_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: OAuth2 refresh token.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_RATE_LIMIT
environmentVariables.description: Maximum sends per minute. Defaults to 10.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to omit write tools and mailbox writers.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_SAVE_TO_SENT
environmentVariables.description: Set to false to skip the IMAP Sent copy after SMTP. Defaults to true.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_WATCHER_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to start the IMAP IDLE watcher.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_WATCHER_FOLDERS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated folders to watch. Defaults to INBOX.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_WATCHER_IDLE_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: IMAP IDLE timeout in seconds. Defaults to 1740.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_HOOK_ON_NEW_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: What to do on arrival: triage, notify, or none.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_HOOK_PRESET
environmentVariables.description: Hook preset: inbox-zero, gtd, priority-focus, notification-only, or custom.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_HOOK_AUTO_LABEL
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to apply labels from hook triage.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_HOOK_AUTO_FLAG
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to flag mail from hook triage.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_HOOK_BATCH_DELAY
environmentVariables.description: Seconds to batch arrivals before hooks run. Defaults to 5.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_HOOK_CUSTOM_INSTRUCTIONS
environmentVariables.description: Extra instructions appended to the hook preset.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_ALERT_DESKTOP
environmentVariables.description: Set to true for desktop notifications.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_ALERT_SOUND
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to play a sound with desktop notifications.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_ALERT_URGENCY_THRESHOLD
environmentVariables.description: Minimum urgency for an alert: urgent, high, normal, or low.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL
environmentVariables.description: HTTP or HTTPS URL that receives alert POSTs.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_ALERT_WEBHOOK_ALLOW_PRIVATE
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to allow webhook targets on a LAN, VPN, or tailnet.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_HOOK_AUTO_CALENDAR
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to create calendar events from hook triage.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_HOOK_CALENDAR_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Calendar name for automatic events.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_HOOK_CALENDAR_ALARM_MINUTES
environmentVariables.description: Minutes before an automatic event to alarm. Defaults to 15.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_HOOK_CALENDAR_CONFIRM
environmentVariables.description: Set to false to skip confirming automatic calendar events. Defaults to true.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_SYSTEM_ONE_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to classify residue mail with System One. Off by default.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_HTTP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: HTTP listen address. Defaults to loopback. The host argument wins.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token. Required when the HTTP listen address is not loopback or MCP_EMAIL_HTTP_ALLOWED_HOSTS lists a non-loopback name.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_HTTP_ALLOWED_HOSTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated Host names. Required for 0.0.0.0 and ::.
